## Our Prototyping & Wireframing Process [...] A healthcare startup wanted to build a patient portal but was unsure whether older users could understand the appointment scheduling, document upload, and profile management flows.

### Our UX Approach

Devisgon created user flow diagrams, low fidelity wireframes, and a high fidelity clickable prototype, then tested the scheduling journey with representative users to find confusion points before development.

### Measurable Impact [...] Prototyping helps teams find unclear flows, missing screens, usability problems, and weak product logic before development costs increase. It gives founders, designers, developers, and stakeholders a shared reference. Fixing problems in a prototype is faster and cheaper than rebuilding finished code.

### 4. Incremental Prototyping (UX Equivalent: Module-Based Prototyping)

Different features are prototyped separately and later combined. Simulates not just UI, but logic.

Real Example

A SaaS Dashboard team prototypes features separately:
